description: A ground-level photograph captures a coastal salt marsh environment under a partly cloudy sky. The foreground is dominated by dense, tall green grass, consistent with vegetated beds found in salt marshes or saline reed beds. Beyond this lush vegetation, the mid-ground transitions to a flatter, lighter brown area with sparser vegetation or exposed muddy sediments, indicative of a less vegetated part of the marsh. In the background, a line of houses with light-coloured walls and red roofs is visible along a distant hillside, illustrating the proximity of urban development to this natural wetland. The image shows the characteristic land cover of a salt marsh, potentially part of an estuary or delta area.
